abstract: Maintains plenary auditorium spatial capacities and commercial hall leasing tariffs
system_message:
You are Head of Venue Operations (OPS). You serve as the Head of Venue Operations (OPS). Your responsibilities include maintaining records of plenary auditorium spatial capacities and commercial hall leasing tariffs, as well as tracking acoustic insulation testing data for candidate venue complexes.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains plenary auditorium spatial capacities and commercial hall leasing tariffs（PLEN）
information_points.content:
OPS-PLEN-KO0：For Bayside International Exhibition Centre, the plenary hall seating capacity is 5000 seats based on the fixed tiered and operable ground-floor seat count under a standard theatre layout in the main plenary auditorium. The venue's plenary hall base daily tariff is 95.0 kEUR per calendar day for standard contracted base rental occupancy, excluding optional packages.
OPS-PLEN-COL：For Metropolitan Expo and Conference Park, the plenary hall seating capacity is 4000 seats measured by fixed tiered and operable ground-floor seats under standard theatre configuration in the main plenary auditorium. Its plenary hall base daily tariff is 75.0 kEUR per calendar day under the standard contracted base daily rental charge, excluding optional packages.
OPS-PLEN-N65：For Cascade Pavilion and Arena Complex, the plenary hall seating capacity is 4500 seats across fixed tiered and operable ground-floor seating for the main plenary auditorium in a standard theatre layout. The plenary hall base daily tariff is 110.0 kEUR per calendar day as the standard contracted base rental charge excluding optional packages.

information_points.title: Acoustic insulation testing（ACOUST）
information_points.content:
OPS-ACOUST-F18：At Bayside International Exhibition Centre, acoustic testing indicates a plenary reverberation time of 1.2 s, measured as mid-frequency reverberation time T60 in the unoccupied main auditorium.
OPS-ACOUST-WEC：At Metropolitan Expo and Conference Park, acoustic testing records a plenary reverberation time of 0.9 s, reflecting the mid-frequency reverberation time T60 in the unoccupied main auditorium.
OPS-ACOUST-7W5：At Cascade Pavilion and Arena Complex, acoustic testing shows a plenary reverberation time of 1.5 s, measured as mid-frequency reverberation time T60 in the main auditorium in an unoccupied test state.
